parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range for the query.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: The start of the time range for the query.

parameters.name: strategy
parameters.description:
The data aggregation policy. The default value is `max`.

Data is collected at a frequency of 1 minute. If you query data over a long time range, the automatic step size for data display may exceed 1 minute. In this case, metrics are aggregated. This parameter specifies the aggregation logic.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun maxcompute query-tunnel-metric --start-time 1735534322 --end-time 1735536322 --metric slot_usage --strategy max --quota-nickname default --project project_a --table-list tab_name --operation-list upload --code-list 403 --group-list quota --topn 10 --region cn-hangzhou
